jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (full remote / hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
Based in Barcelona, Qustodio is a fast-growing internet safety startup whose mission is to provide a safe digital experience for every child. Our top product is a multi-platform parental control solution that is used and loved by hundreds of thousands of families worldwide, and is one of the leading brands worldwide in the Digital Wellbeing category.

Qustodio is growing and we have some amazing challenges to face. From our Operation Team, we provide service to hundreds of thousand of users all around the world. We have an already well established and high performance platform that provides high availability and to our users. At this point of our evolution, we are looking to add a new member to our operations team that helps us to keep improving our platform and to keep improving pipelines and procedures.

What is our mission as a team?

The platform team is aimed to keep evolving our infrastructure providing the technological infrastructure for bringing our customers the greatest... experience. We are encourage to modernize our well established system to be more flexible, stand on high quality standards and help teams to bring features and improvements faster.

So, if you:
• Have experience managing orchestrated environments like Kubernetes
• Knows about Helm charts and knows how to craft them
• Care about quality and like to get things done the right way
• Have a comprehensive knowledge on networking
• Feel the need of having ownership on challenges
• Have expertise with the AWS services ecosystem
• Are interested in making things agile: by understanding and applying automation

What can we offer you:
• Great culture - friendly and emphasises both teamwork and fun.
• Our company is home to over 15 nationalities.
• Flexible working hours - and there are possibilities to work from home.
• Interesting challenges in a fast-growing technology company for you to grind your skills.
• Competitive salary range.
• Private health insurance.
• In-house training and team building events.
• A modern and fully equipped office headquarters in Barcelona city center,
• Daily fruit and beverages supply.
• Daily catering for lunch.
• 23 days of holidays per year. Half day off on your b'day.
• Flexible benefits

jobs_results.description:
DevOps Manager

€60,000 - €80,000

Basque-Country - Hybrid

​

WHY JOIN THE TEAM?
• LEAD A TEAM OF MORE JUNIOR ENGINEERS
• AUTONOMY TO LEAD PROJECTS FROM A TECHNICAL POINT
• OPPORTUNITY TO OWN AND NURTURE A FUNCTION

​

The Ideal profile
• Work and support a team of DevOps Engineers and technical decision-makers to define the strategic vision for delivery
• Make complex decisions involving a wide range of solutions, possibly affecting several work areas within the organisation.
• DevOps Prowess: In-depth knowledge of DevOps principles and experience with release and deployment tools.
• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or Architect, with a strong background in managing cloud-based infrastructures.
• Deep expertise in AWS services, Kubernetes, and containerisation technologies.
• Design state-of-the-art technical solutions on AWS that are scalable, reliable, secure, and meet performance requirements.
• Experience establishing standards and procedures across a service lifecycle... including the development lifecycle
• Mentoring or managing experience would be ideal.

​

​

For more info

If you feel this is the role for you or you know someone suitable for the role.

Email me at Adalberto.pinto@staffhostdigital.com

​

Thank you for your interest in this opportunity. If your application is successful, we will contact you to discuss the position in more detail within 48 hours of receiving your CV. Please assume your application been unsuccessful if you do not hear back from us within 48 hours

jobs_results.title: AWS DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer to join Cloud project team. The ideal candidate will have a strong skills and experience in planning, coding, development, testing, release and deployment of AWS services using AWS native tools.
Our Cloud project team is setting up AWS platform and services. Planning & designing of AWS platform is complete. Building & testing of AWS platform is in progress. Cloud service setup is also in progress. From April applications are expected to host applications in AWS platform/environment.

Your Day-to-Day:
In this role, you will be responsible for building and qualifying AWS services. You will work closely with Architecture, Operations, Network, Service SME and Security teams to ensure the smooth development and release of AWS services.
• Plan, code, build, test and release AWS services
• Support operations team in deployment of AWS services using IaC
• Ensure configuration and compliance of AWS services using AWS native tools
• Participate... and contribute in development of CI/CD pipeline
• Development of Infrastructure products and deploying with Service Catalog portfolio
• Work on automation backlog
• Work on documentation
• Monitor application performance
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues with AWS services
• Provide effective utilization of AWS services
• Support application/development teams to deploy applications onto AWS environment
• Collaborate with other IT teams to ensure the smooth operation of the overall AWS services

What you need:
• 3+ years of experience as DevOps Engineer
• Experience with CloudShell, CodeBuild, CodeCommit,
• Experience with AWS CloudFormation
• Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash)
• Experience with JSON, YAML
• Experience in automation of AWS Service Catalog portfolio and product deployment by using AWS Cloud Development Kit
• Knowledge of security best practices in AWS cloud
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to haves:
• Experience with Terraform
• Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and ECS
• Experience with database administration, particularly RDS and Aurora
• Knowledge of agile software development methodologies

Benefits:
• Advantage of working in a large, stable, and reliable company, which managed to keep a dynamic and friendly work environment.
• Experience in international projects for first-rate global companies.
• Attractive salary and compensation package (advanced health insurance, flexible cell phone compensation, etc.)
• Company-sponsored professional training and certifications.
• Active/passive participation in professional international conferences.
• Career growth and opportunities for development.
• Regular company and team-building events.
• Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere (depending on the project

jobs_results.title: Digital Platform Azure DevOps Lead
jobs_results.via: via Careers At Mars - Mars, Incorporated
jobs_results.description:
Job Description:

Petcare Growth Digital Platform team is in search of an experienced Azure DevOps Lead Engineer to oversee the implementation and management of DevOps practices and tools within our GDP Azure environment. This role will require a combination of technical expertise, leadership skills, and a deep understanding of DevOps principles and Azure technologies. This role will operate at a global level and will have to coordinate the Products development teams using the Azure platform.

What are we looking for?
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience and strong proficiency as an Azure DevOps lead in a multi products multinational environment.
• Azure infrastructure and Services: very familiar with Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Container Instances, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, and other Azure services used in DevOps workflows.
• Excellent... problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Leadership and mentoring abilities.
• Continuous Learning and Improvement.
• Leadership and Team Management: this role may require to run a 2-3 DevOps engineer team over time.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
What will be your key responsibilities?
• DevOps Strategy Development: He/She collaborates with key stakeholders to develop and refine the organization's DevOps strategy, including defining goals, objectives, and metrics for success. He/She also assesses the current state of DevOps practices and identifies areas for improvement.
• Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Proficiency in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Services or Azure DevOps Server. This includes defining build and release processes, automating testing, and deploying applications to Azure environments.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with infrastructure automation using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure DevTest Labs. He/She should be able to set up monitoring solutions to track the performance, availability, and health of Azure resources and applications.
• Security and Compliance: Understanding of security best practices fir Azure environments, including identity and access management (IAM), network security, encryption, and compliance standards such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC. He/She should ensure that DevOps processes and infrastructure are designed and implemented with security in mind (DevSecOps)
• Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, Bash for automating tasks and managing Azure resources programmatically. He/She should be able to write scripts to automate deployment, configuration, and maintenance tasks.

What can you expect from Mars?
• Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
• Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
• Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
• An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request

jobs_results.title: SRE / Devops Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

As a SRE / DevOps Engineers at Fever you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable infrastructures, with a keen focus on automation.

If you’re... experienced developing infrastructures using AWS services, have strong knowledge on how to build CI/CD pipelines and you build systems with a security-first mindset, well then you’re exactly what we are looking for!

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible. This is an opportunity to have real impact in a high-growth global category leader.

About you

Must have skills
• Strong knowledge of DevOps culture, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
• Strong knowledge of Linux administration, troubleshooting and automation using Python and bash scripting.
• Hands-On experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, etc)
• Experience using Kubernetes in production environments.
• Good understanding of Networking and HTTP reverse proxies (OpenVPN, Nginx).
• Professional proficiency in English. You’re able to communicate and collaborate with remote and multidisciplinary teams.

It would be nice if you have
• Database administration knowledge (MySQL & PostgreSQL)
• Experience working as a Site Reliability and Security Engineer.
• Knowledge building service infrastructures for Python/NodeJS environments.
• Knowledge of centralized logging techniques (rsyslog, ELK/EFK).
• An open-minded and passionate approach to technology.
• Experience working on agile environments.

Benefits & Perks
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
• Home office friendly anywhere in Spain.
• Relocation package for international candidates.
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth.
• Great work environment with a young, diverse team of talented people to work with!
• Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee's platform.
• English Lessons.
• Gympass Membership.
• Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary through Payflow.
• Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
• Base Salary: 35.000 - 70.000EUR

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best-fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:
• Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture and a conversation about your background and experience.
• Technical Assignment: Your opportunity to demonstrate all you know! We would like to receive it back within 3 days.
• Team Interview - 1.5h: A discussion about your proposed solution to the technical challenge. And your opportunity to ask anything you need to know about your day to day at Fever.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
More than 3.5 billion people globally cannot obtain access to high quality health services due to poor health systems, inadequate infrastructure, and human resource gaps.​Cardo Health is an impact start-up with a mission to democratize access to healthcare – starting with emerging markets. With strained public healthcare systems and many uninsured inhabitants, there is an enormous potential to transform the health sector in these markets.

Local digital health start-ups, meanwhile, face challenges such as access to funding and often sub-optimal technology.

WHAT WE DO

Cardo Health addresses these challenges by investing in the most talented local entrepreneurs, providing them with funding, world-class scalable technology, and extensive operational know-how in digital health.

We are building our first Software Engineering team based in Barcelona that will be tasked with building a global platform delivering on-demand healthcare to most in demand communities.

Platform resilience and... up-time is super important and we are hiring a DevOps Team that can ensure we build a scalable, fault tolerant environment that enables us to release and deploy rapidly.

We have built a modern stack using, NodeJS, React, MySql, Github actions, Terraform for infra-as-code, K8s and Docker! We ar currently deployed onto AWS but are building for a multi cloud future as we deploy in multiple countries.

The DevSecOps expert owns the development delivery process and collaborates with the delivery team to continuously improve it. They will drive the team’s engineering practices in test driven development, continuous integration, and automated deployment. They are a hands-on team member who actively coaches the team to solve complex problems in order to increase speed of delivery, improve quality/security of code, and optimize processes for the development team. The DevSecOps expert delivers infrastructure-as-code deployment tooling and supporting services on multiple cloud providers along with metrics and login.

Responsibilities:
• Guides DevOps teams on speed of delivery, improving quality/security of code, and optimizing processesMentors and coaches the technical team
• Be hands on and engage in coding to help the team to develop his solution and solve all surfacing problems at hand Identifies and removes technical impediments
• Constantly looking for better ways of solving technical problems and designing the solution, not afraid of challenging the status quo
• Provides the team a roadmap for implementing software engineering practices for higher code qualityIdentifies bottlenecks in coding development and deployment processes
• Leads planning delivery time, code quality, and process efficiency improvement projects
• Executes on plan by building coding standardizations and automating processes for the organization
• Leads knowledge growth effort of platform configuration management and troubleshooting
• Collaborates with the rest of delivery team to deliver consistent and holistic solution to the organization

Key Skills:
• Seen as an expert within the technical components of the domains/products/journeys
• Excellent coding and scripting skills (Bash, Perl) and experience with implementing high-scale cloud architectures using modern, cloud-based container platforms (PaaS/SaaS)
• Experience of deployment automation solutions (i.e. Terraform. Puppet, Chef, Ansible)
• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and cluster management tools like Kubernetes
• Experience with containers such as Docker, OpenShift and continuous integration and related tools such as Jenkins, Hudson, Maven, Ant, Git, Sonar, etc.
• Experience of integrating security in the CI, CD pipelines
• Experience in Agile Development and implementing CI, CD at scale Experience as a DevOps or SRE Lead on a cross-functional agile team
• Understands relationship with Product Owner, Scrum Master, Design Lead and rest of technical team.
• Experience managing technical priorities within the BacklogStrong communication skills with ability to align the organization on complex technical decisions
• Active coach and mentor whose goals are to grow and maximize the team’s potential
• High energy and passionate individual who inspires teammates to reach their maximum potential
• Excited about trying new solutions outside standard approved
• Embraces a culture of trust, free thought complete transparencyBrave and rebellious, willing to challenge status quo

jobs_results.title: Global DevOps Engineer (all genders)
jobs_results.description:
Full-time

Are you ready for new challenges in an international and innovation-driven environment where you can make a difference? Apply and join our team, be curious, learn, grow, and develop your career together with us. We promise: you are in for a special ride!

The location of the role is in; Oviedo

For this position, we are open to both junior & senior candidates

About the job

As a Global DevOps Engineer, you will report directly to the Head of Digital & Cloud Solution Delivery. In this position, you will play an important role in the Digital Transformation of RHI Magnesita, supporting our development of technical solutions. You will primarily deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure, using infrastructure as code through DevOps methodologies. By being a part of the Digital & Cloud Solution Delivery department, you will support our main initiatives. You will work in alignment with the rest of our teams and other IT areas, following corporate standards, proposing new ideas, and... keeping all activities well-documented.

In addition, your tasks will include
• Receiving and synthesizing data about our customer business and technical requirements and addressing them with technical architecture(s)
• Understanding our customer technical environments and mapping architecture/digital transformation solutions to customer business outcomes
• Supporting our teams in building the DevOps development cycle and deploying/maintaining their infrastructure in Azure with your technical expertise
• Providing guidance and support with technical expertise to the teams for building our cloud infrastructure and developing features for our cloud solutions

About You

You are a strong communicator with a collaborative attitude. With your great enthusiasm and creative mindset, you bring new ideas to the table, not only as an individual but also together with your colleagues. You work well in cross-functional teams and are not afraid to take responsibility and make decisions. With your hands-on mentality, structured approach and analytical skills, you proactively seek to improve the status quo. You see change as something positive, can adapt quickly and you like to courageously help shape the future of RHI Magnesita.

What we expect from you in terms of

Education & Skills
• A bachelor's or master’s degree in information technology, computer science/engineering, or similar areas of relevance
• Knowledge using modern Web UI technologies – Angular JS, HTML5, React, CSS3 & Angular
• Knowledge of security best practices in infrastructure, application, IAM, or data platform solutions
• Knowledge of Microsoft tools and platforms like Active Directory, System Center, Power BI, Azure, Office 365, etc.

Languages
• English – Advanced

Work Experience
• Some years of relevant professional experience
• Experience in architecture, design, configuration, and deployment within the Microsoft Azure platform

Why you should work for RHI Magnesita

You will perform in a customer focused environment. We live innovation and appreciate an open and pragmatic way of working. From our leaders we expect to drive our further transformation, to engage our people and to give direction. RHI Magnesita is a company where you can be yourself and where not only your resume and experience, but also your personality counts. We aim for global consistency in compensation policies, but also consider local common practices. RHI Magnesita is committed to support its employees through various means to enable the best possible performance.

We offer
• A permanent contract
• Flexible working hours for the perfect balance between your professional and personal life
• RHIM Academy for your ongoing learning & development, including full LinkedIn Learning catalogue
• Meal allowance
• Private medical insurance
• Possibility of up to 50% home office
• Empowerment to take responsibility and forge your own career success
• Opportunities to learn, lead, and build something new with colleagues from around the world

Sounds like you?

At RHI Magnesita everyone is welcome and encouraged to apply. We evaluate applications based on required qualifications and regardless of gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status. At RHI Magnesita we appreciate the value of diverse teams.

We kindly ask you to submit your application online and in English. Due to data privacy reasons, applications via e-mail cannot be taken into consideration. Should you have any questions about this position, please contact us at: talent.europe@rhimagnesita.com

Agencies may only submit candidates for positions for which they have been invited to do so by the Head of Talent Acquisition Europe. All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of RHI Magnesita and our company will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

About RHI Magnesita

We are the acknowledged technology leader in the refractory industry. Our company is defined by people. We are committed to diversity and know that multiple approaches, perspectives and backgrounds fuel creativity and innovation. It is our aspiration to build a workplace culture where everyone feels valued, engages, and can enjoy a truly inclusive environment and the diverse voices of our employees are heard. We foster a collaborative culture that cherishes ideas and determination to add value for our customers. Our leadership style encourages open-mindedness, reliability, pragmatism, and innovation.

Find & follow us: www.rhimagnesita.com

LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube

Your tasks will include the operation and maintenance of IT systems for the specialist procedures supported in the service area (including trade, restaurants, weapons, regulatory offenses, lost property management and fire inspection). This includes monitoring and troubleshooting, ensuring the required availability, carrying out operational security measures (e.g. installing releases from internal and external process manufacturers, restarting applications) and system optimizations. In all these activities, you will always work together with your team colleagues and in close coordination with our customers in the district administration department and the fire department, the external product manufacturers, the internal and external partner procedures and our infrastructure teams. Occasionally, the job requires you to work outside of core working hours. This can occasionally lead to weekend work or on-call duty. jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Azure)
jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

Our Tech team is looking for a DevOps Engineer with experience in Azure for our new office in Sofia. This is a key player role for establishing and growing the product development teams in Bulgaria.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Develop & Optimize: Craft and scale cloud-native solutions in Azure. Your mission is to make our cloud setup smarter, faster, and more efficient.
• Team Up: Join forces with application teams on cloud projects. Enhance our CI/CD pipelines for smoother, quicker deployments.
• Explore & Implement: Dive into cloud engineering, focusing on innovative infrastructure solutions that tackle complex... challenges.
• Brings 3+ years of experience with MS Azure and a total of 5+ years in the DevOps arena to the table. AWS gurus willing and able to learn fast are also welcome.
• Understands containerization concepts and is eager to apply this knowledge in a practical setting.
• Has a grasp of cloud security, networking, and is familiar with web apps, integration scenarios and databases (Postgres, NoSQL).
• Has profound knowledge in Azure cloud network security and deeply understands the concepts of private endpoints, private DNS and traffic routing.
• Is comfortable navigating GitOps and CI/CD tools, with a knack for scripting (Bash, Python) and Bitbucket pipelining.
• Knows the ins and outs of APIM and authentication flows, including authentication mechanisms for PaaS, JWT tokens and B2C model, ensuring our applications are both secure and scalable.
• Expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and JSON driven terraform infrastructure.
• Be at the forefront of our cloud journey in Sofia, directly shaping our infrastructure and deployment strategies.
• Enjoy a role that blends strategic planning with hands-on execution in a dynamic, agile environment.
• Seize opportunities for professional growth in a setting that values innovation and practical problem-solving.

What we offer:
• Competitive salary
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage
• Additional days of holidays
• Free language classes
• Free Multisport card
• Possibility of working from home up to 4 days per week during the first months
